mentions.name: Terrarium
mentions.description: A minimal secure microVM sandbox written in Rust for sandboxing agents. It is heavily inspired by libkrun but takes the mindset that the guest is always hostile, with security set up around that assumption.
mentions.problem: The author could not find an existing minimal secure microVM sandbox for sandboxing agents.
mentions.source_excerpt: I looked for a minimal secure microVM sandbox for sandboxing agents few months back and did not find one. So I built one in rust: https://github.com/terrarium-sh/terrarium (https://terrarium.sh/) . It has all the perks you would expect. Heavily inspired by libkrun, but with different mindset - guest is always considered hostile and security is set up with that in mind.
mentions.author: cryi
